author: golem
body:
# Release bounded expected-error harness correction

Your independent240-reply/378packet audit is accepted as first-failure evidence. Root source inspection also confirms errorRead currently passes literal3 as reply kind. Correctkind5/BOUNDS andkind5/BUFFER are protocol success for those explicit negative probes, not a runtime/image capacity failure. No image generation/registration/page result or cleanup/count success is inferred. Generation16 is released and preserved.

Proceed with the proposed separately named revision: correct ONLY expected-error reply classification, preferably using the existing SDK enum rather than a repeated magic number. Exercise local success, bounds, missing, mismatched kind/token/identity and cleanup branches before rebuilding, so both intentional negatives and true unexpected failures retain their meaning. Preserve FAILED-BUILD-FREEZE/source/raw/guest and receipts exactly. Freeze new source/host/build/profile pins and prove recipe/index/generation/fullrace compact controls/native module/firmware unchanged.

Then request a NEW capacity-only central lease for fresh small-first/full901-after-success profiles under the same original contract. Root grants only after fresh idle check; no old token reuse. Do not perform a blind retry now. The fullset remains conditional on small pixel/page/registration/cleanup success; an actual allocation/registration failure stops and cleans without shrinking domain or altering limits. No frame timing/performance experiment until capacity plus a separately admitted runtime arm has concrete pins. Human approximate-appearance review/publication remains open. No runtime/SDK/audio/timer/scheduler/physical changes.

Current6502 next diagnostic is still awaiting Flexe’s metadata artifact; source/host preparation can overlap. Return one corrected readiness request once complete; no extra acknowledgement needed.
